Position Description & Qualifications

Serco-NA is seeking a motivated individual to serve as an IB-CHE/PMDT Developer in the Submarine Industrial Base Data Analytics Team, (IB-CHE: Industrial Base – Cloud Hosting Environment/ PMDT: Product & Manufacturing Digital Twin) supporting high-visibility initiatives that enhance the readiness, resilience, and performance of the U.S. Navy’s Submarine Industrial Base (SIB).

Must be able to obtain U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.

In this role, you will systematically map, analyze, and plan the digital transformation efforts across all areas/departments. The core deliverable is a comprehensive portfolio that outlines current capabilities, future requirements, and strategic roadmaps for technology integration, ensuring all digital investments are aligned, and directly support mission objectives.

This position operates in a fast-paced environment requiring daily interaction with suppliers, government stakeholders, and industry partners. You must be a self-starter capable of independently identifying issues, analyzing complex datasets, developing actionable insights, and communicating performance outcomes to senior leadership.

Working remotely, you will be on the dynamic SIB Data Team providing support to the Program Manager and DRPM SUB where you will help manage a dynamic mix of in-house development teams and third-party tool integration projects to deliver solutions that support the SIB program. Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on our military defense and safety of our sailors.

Program Overview

The Submarine Industrial Base (SIB) Program leads the U.S. Navy's effort to revitalize America's shipbuilding and repair capabilities. Established in September 2024, the program strengthens and expands the industrial base that builds and maintains surface ships, aircraft carriers, and submarines vital to national defense.

https://www.secnav.navy.mil/rda/mib/Pages/default.aspx

DRPM Subs Is Responsible For

The acquisition of COLUMBIA Class Submarines, including R&D, design, construction, Test and Evaluation (T&E), and Live Fire Test and Evaluation (LFT&E). This program is a major defense acquisition effort with significant Congressional and OSD visibility.The acquisition of VIRGINIA Class Submarines, including lifecycle management, T&E, LFT&E, and Fleet introduction, with an estimated lifecycle cost of $336B.The SSN(X) program, responsible for next-generation fast attack submarine design and acquisition, emphasizing speed, stealth, payload capacity, and operational endurance.

Serco supports the US Navy as prime for SHAPM contract supporting the acquisition of submarines and surface vessels.

In This Role, You Will

Build Web Sites on Gov Cloud: Design and update website layouts and user interfaces using modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript standards.Connect Back-End Services: Integrate and develop APIs to Gov Cloud databases and external web services.Optimize Performance: Ensure fast page loading speeds, mobile responsiveness, and cross-browser compatibility.Troubleshoot and Test: Monitor site performance, fix bugs, and run quality checks.Reviews, analyzes, and modifies programming systems including encoding, testing, debugging and documenting programsExperience with Industry 4.0., Additive Manufacturing, and Non-Destructive Testing workflows.Help fill any knowledge gap in digital requirements for Industry 4.0 to enable and then eventually sustain them beyond MVP status (includes things such as data lakes, S3 buckets, ATOs, possible IB-CHE integration dynamics, operational costs, etc).Familiar with a variety of field’s concepts, practices, and procedures.Support data ingestion, processing, and visualization workflows to deliver actionable insights to government stakeholders.Collaborate with a cross-functional team of analysts, data engineers, front-end developers, and subject matter experts to deliver mission-critical solutions.Present findings through reports, dashboards, and briefings to both technical and non-technical audiences.Performs a variety of complicated tasks.Report progress and metrics to the Data Director and other senior stakeholders.Provide program, analytical, and acquisition management support to senior level SIB executives as required.Work with the SIB team, which is spread across the United States focused on workforce development/marketing, supply chain/sustainment, and technology developments.Interact with industry and senior leadership.Contribute to the development of data-driven insights and analytic solutions that help identify, assess, and mitigate risks in complex supply chains.You will partner closely with Product Owners, the Data Director, and other stakeholders to maintain delivery cadence, transparency, and accountability.

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Have

The ability to obtain a DoW Secret security clearance.A Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in data science, analytics, Industry 4.0, or applied machine learning or similar/related experience.Technical Knowledge: Strong command of development languages HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.Programming Languages: Familiarity with backend languages or frameworks (such as PHP, Python, Ruby on Rails, or Node.js).Tools and CMS: Experience with version control tools (like Git).Gov Cloud CyberSecurity: Experience developing cybersecure and certified websites on DoW Networks. Rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical insights clearly.Strong communication (both written and oral), facilitation, and conflict-resolution skills.A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected. Customer-oriented team player mindset focused on mission who is self-motivated, driven and can work independently and remotely.The ability to travel 10%.

If you feel your skillset is a match to the requirements, then you should be ready to take the next step in your career path, apply today!

About The Position

We're looking for smart and curious individuals to join our growing team and drive our ML work.

On our Machine Learning team, you'll build the deep learning models that power our trading strategies, supported by our rapidly growing computing cluster with tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges-large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment-that force us to search for novel techniques.

At Jane Street, our researchers, engineers, and traders sit a few feet away from each other and work together to train models, architect systems, and run trading strategies. Depending on the day, we might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging distributed training performance, or studying how our model likes to trade in production.

We'll rely on your in-depth knowledge of the machine learning landscape and understanding of a variety of approaches-drawn from LLMs, image models, RL agents, recommendation systems, or classical ML methods-to shape the future of ML at Jane Street. You'll train models for the next generation of our deep learning-based trading strategies, and build the fundamental understanding we need to tackle new markets and situations. You'll also be hiring new colleagues, attending conferences, and teaching techniques to teammates-all of which we consider to be real and impactful parts of the job.

If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. There's no fixed set of skills we are looking for, but you should bring:

Practical experience working on empirical ML problemsThe ability to apply logical and mathematical thinking to all kinds of problemsIntellectual curiosity and excitement about state-of-the-art research across many ML problem domainsFluency with a versatile set of models and tricksThe hands-on coding skills needed to rapidly implement and iterate on your ideas, in Python and your favorite ML frameworkAn eagerness to ask questions, admit mistakes, and learn new things

We're looking for smart and curious individuals to join our growing team and drive our ML work.

Trading poses unusual challenges-large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment-that force us to search for novel techniques.

About The Role

Quvia is deploying Grid, our AI-powered platform that dynamically routes network traffic to optimize connectivity and performance, with enterprise customers in the U.S. We're looking for the engineer or scientist who makes it perform.

The core problem is getting finite satellite bandwidth to the right users at the right time, under contested and fast-changing conditions. Capacity shifts as satellites move, demand is bursty and mission-driven, and the answer has to be both good and fast. If you've built scheduling, network flow, or supply-chain optimization systems at scale, you already know the math. The domain is the only new part.

You'll be embedded with enterprise customer as the senior technical owner of Grid's optimization layer. This is hands-on work, not advisory. You'll formulate the models, write the code, choose the solvers, and profile the results yourself. You'll also translate in both directions: turning mission constraints into problems Grid can solve, and explaining what the models can and can't do in terms program leads can act on.
